prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption (new_screen, redesign) and sign_in (reorder) changes because only one test has been completed for each.
Evidence is still thin for finish, new_screen changes because the two completed tests disagreed on outcome.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -0.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Account Authentication Shift: Move the sign-in prompt to appear after pet selection and certificate creation rather than before friend selection. (why: Sign-in causes a 27.1% drop early in onboarding; moving it after pet selection leverages user investment before asking for credentials.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Two Column Split Friend Picker Layout: Rebuild the pet selection screen into a split two-column layout with animated pet previews alongside choice cards. (why: Adoption is the lowest converting onboarding step at 60.9%, with high median duration (89s) indicating confusion when selecting a friend.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Pet Interaction Quick Start Tips Screen: Insert a dedicated quick tips screen right before the final home screen outlining key desktop controls and interaction hotkeys. (why: Support received multiple tickets regarding post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
3: [home, new_flow] Desktop Visibility Status Check Flow: Introduce an active desktop overlay status verification and readiness notification flow during the waiting phase. (why: Three support tickets reported pets failing to appear on the desktop or app startup issues, while the waiting step has high mean time.)
4: [home, wait_info] Generation Progress Tip Carousel: Add an informative tip carousel component to the waiting screen to engage users while pet assets generate. (why: The waiting screen has a high median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-offs while waiting for pet creation.)
5: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Intro Journey Redesign: Redesign the initial story screen into a smooth story scroll layout introducing companion benefits before path selection. (why: The choose path step drops 23.8% of users with a high mean time of 514s, showing early friction before path commitment.)
6: [finish, notification] Desktop Control Shortcut Toast Notification: Add a notification badge component on the home intro screen displaying hotkeys for summoning pet controls. (why: Users spend a median 395s on finish and support tickets highlight post-onboarding confusion regarding pet controls.)
7: [adoption, layout] Compact Pet Photo Upload Screen: Change the upload photo screen to a compact layout with clear formatting guidance for photo selection. (why: Three support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or bad visual output when uploading custom pet photos.)

scores.note: Target step loses 27.1% of users. Evidence relies on funnel data without direct support mail backing. Single previous test yielded +0.7%.
Adoption has the lowest conversion (60.9%), making impact potential highest. Evidence thin on redesigns; single previous test showed +0.4%.
Strong evidence from support tickets and duration, but adding new screens to finish step previously yielded negative relative change (-0.5%).
Both support tickets and high mean wait duration point to friction during home setup, though implementing a new flow requires custom development.
High wait time (201s median) offers solid opportunity to retain users via in-place info component at moderate cost.
Initial step drops 23.8% of traffic with high mean duration, but evidence comes solely from funnel data.
